title: Great tour with expert guide. Eva is knowledgeable and resourceful. Great to walk you through the mysteries of Granada
text: She made a long and detailed tour feel easy with interesting facts, historic details and funny jokes about Granada’s secret and darker past.
author: Rafael331

title: Highly recommended experience
text: We had a great time with Eva, a charming person, friendly, close and a great guide. We recommend without hesitation the inexplicable Granada route if you want to know Granada from a different and special point of view! Thank you, Eva, for a unique night! Let's not stop consuming culture!
author: O4035PSmariam

title: Superb experience
text:
I went with my partner and we had a great time. Eva is passionate about her work and is 100% involved. During the visit he also complemented everything he told us with videos, audios and photographs. What makes the experience different you want more.

If you want to know the most distinguished secrets of Granada this is your tour.
author: HalWilkerson

title: Very interesting and highly recommended
text: A different visit, but certainly very interesting. Our guide Eva explained everything phenomenal, also telling us many historical facts of the city and recommending many other places to visit. Definitely 100% recommended. If we return to Granada, we will contact her. A different tour but lets you know more about the beautiful city of Granada
author: Adrianavicente32

title: 100% recommended
text:
Interesting visit through the center of Granada that offers a different vision, with legends and mysteries of the city throughout its history.
Very good personal treatment, close and in the company of an excellent narrator.
author: larrag2020

title: Grenada
text: We loved the visit, we will return to Granada to do a tour with Eva, it was very nice to be with them.
